input.prompt:
GOAL: Every weekday (Mon–Fri) at ~8:00am America/Chicago (Austin time), send the owner a ONE-LINE weather summary for Austin, TX. This job fires every 30 minutes; most firings must stay silent.

STEPS:
1. Get the current time in America/Chicago via mac_shell: `TZ=America/Chicago date '+%u %H %M %Y-%m-%d'` (fields: weekday 1=Mon..7=Sun, hour, minute, date).
2. GATE: proceed only if weekday is 1–5 AND hour == 08. Otherwise stop silently (task_complete: "outside window, no delivery").
3. DEDUPE: memory_recall key `sched:austin-weather:last-sent`. If it equals today's date (YYYY-MM-DD, Chicago), stop silently (task_complete: "already sent today").
4. Fetch weather via mac_shell (no Playwright): `curl -s --max-time 15 "https://wttr.in/Austin,TX?u&format=%C,+%t+(feels+%f),+high/low+via+j1"` — simpler: `curl -s --max-time 15 "https://wttr.in/Austin,TX?format=j1&u"` and read current_condition[0] (weatherDesc, temp_F, FeelsLikeF) and weather[0] (maxtempF, mintempF, max chanceofrain across hourly). If wttr.in fails, try `curl -s "https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=30.2672&longitude=-97.7431&current=temperature_2m,weather_code&daily=temperature_2m_max,temperature_2m_min,precipitation_probability_max&temperature_unit=fahrenheit&timezone=America/Chicago&forecast_days=1"`.
5. Compose exactly one line (Slack mrkdwn, no headers/tables), e.g.: `🌤️ Austin today: Partly cloudy, 68°F now (feels 66°F) · High 84° / Low 63° · 10% rain`.
6. channel_send to channel `sl`, chat_id `D0EVAL` with that line.
7. memory_write key `sched:austin-weather:last-sent` = today's date (Chicago).
8. If both weather sources fail, send one line: "⚠️ Couldn't fetch Austin weather this morning." and still record last-sent.

DELIVERY CONDITION: message only on weekdays during the 08:00–08:59 Chicago hour, at most once per day. Otherwise silent.
